prompt:
Instagram feed post for the Italian restaurant Da Tonino, vertical 4:5. Professional food advertising poster where the photograph and the typography are one single image.

LAYOUT FROM IMAGE 1: warm cream paper background, an enormous dark serif word across the upper half, the food weaving through the letters (in front of some strokes, behind others), a bowl of food in the lower right at a 30-degree three-quarter angle, an italic subtitle under the big word, small spaced caps details on the left, a few real ingredients and crumbs scattered on the surface lower left.

FOOD FROM IMAGE 2, reproduced faithfully: Da Tonino's real Neapolitan pizza prosciutto e rucola, puffy leopard-spotted charred crust, bright tomato, thin pink prosciutto folds, a generous heap of fresh arugula, patches of melted mozzarella, on its dark terracotta round plate. The plate sits lower right at a three-quarter angle. One slice is being lifted out of the pizza and rises upward so that a long real stretch of melted mozzarella and a few arugula leaves wrap through and around the letters of the big word, passing in front of some letters and behind others. A few loose arugula leaves and flakes of crust on the cream surface.

TEXT, printed directly on the cream background, no boxes, no badges, no stickers, no shapes behind text: small top centre in spaced serif caps 'DA TONINO' with 'RISTORANTE' in tiny gold spaced caps below. Giant word in very tall heavy condensed dark espresso serif caps: 'PIZZA'. Under it, large elegant italic serif in near black: 'Prosciutto e rucola'. A thin short gold rule, then small spaced caps: 'TOMATE · MOZZARELLA · PROSCIUTTO · RÚCULA'. Bottom left small italic serif: 'Reserva tu mesa'. Exact spelling, no other text, no logos, no watermark.

PHOTOGRAPHY: shot by a professional food photographer, 85 mm, soft directional key light from the upper left with a real shadow under the plate and the lifted slice, focus plane on the cheese stretch and the slice, the far rim of the plate falls slightly soft, natural grease sheen on the prosciutto, crisp char spots, subtle film grain. It must look photographed, not rendered. Palette: cream paper, espresso brown, tomato red, arugula green, a touch of gold.
